evidence.label: x402 paid prediction
evidence.note: An agent paid 0.001 MUSD for one prediction on POST /api/x402/predict: it signed a Permit2 authorization, the Mezo x402 facilitator submitted it and paid the gas in BTC. Demo provider wallet to treasury.

evidence.label: Fees posted to the Mezo gauge
evidence.note: SiriusFeeRouter.distribute pulled 0.04 MUSD of platform fees from the escrow: 0.02 MUSD to the treasury and 0.02 MUSD posted as an incentive on the BTC/MUSD gauge bribe for veBTC voters.

evidence.label: One-signature payment
evidence.note: A buyer holding only MUSD and no BTC signed a MUSD permit and a lock request; the settlement account submitted lockWithSignature and paid the gas. 2 MUSD locked.

evidence.label: Pay with BTC
evidence.note: A buyer holding only BTC called SiriusCheckout.buyWithBtc: 0.0000256 BTC swapped to 2.01 MUSD on the Mezo Pools BTC/MUSD pool under the oracle floor, then 2 MUSD locked in the escrow, in one transaction.

evidence.label: Release, one-signature loan
evidence.note: Preimage published, provider credited net of the 2 % fee.

evidence.label: Release, BTC loan
evidence.note: Preimage published, provider credited net of the 2 % fee.

evidence.label: Provider withdrawal
evidence.note: The demo provider received 3.92 MUSD: two 2 MUSD runs minus the platform fee.

evidence.label: Earnings into the Stability Pool
evidence.note: The demo provider deposited 1 MUSD of earnings into Mezo's MUSD Stability Pool (provideToSP).

evidence.label: Fees posted to the Mezo gauge (second)
evidence.note: 0.08 MUSD of fees from the one-signature and BTC loans: 0.04 MUSD to the treasury, 0.04 MUSD posted on the BTC/MUSD gauge bribe. 0.06 MUSD posted to veBTC voters in total.

evidence.label: Marketplace purchase through the web app
evidence.note: Full cycle on the live site with MetaMask: three datasets published by three provider wallets, a fourth wallet paid 2 MUSD with one signature (no gas), the logistic model was trained and this settlement released the escrow. Certificate: /certificate/cmw46yuc1000008jthcuy2vdx

evidence.note: Wallet 0xafce23fb6d1aaa83e59e683e50436270be36d739, outside the team, paid 10 MUSD for "Hourly energy demand – regional grid" on the live site with MetaMask.

evidence.label: External buyer: model delivered, escrow released
